fields.terrain: predominately mountainous with large coastal plains
fields.hazards: earthquakes are common, though usually not severe; volcanic activity; volcanism: significant volcanism on North Island; Ruapehu (2,797 m) has a history of large eruptions in the past century…
fields.resources: natural gas, iron ore, sand, coal, timber, hydropower, gold, limestone
fields.farm: milk, beef, kiwifruit, apples, grapes, lamb/mutton, potatoes, wheat, barley, chicken
fields.exports: milk, wood, beef, butter, sheep and goat meat
fields.industries: agriculture, forestry, fishing, logs and wood articles, manufacturing, mining, construction, financial services, real estate services, tourism
fields.languages: English (de facto official) 95.4%, Maori (de jure official) 4%, Samoan 2.2%, Northern Chinese 2%, Hindi 1.5%, French 1.2%, Yue 1.1%, New Zealand Sign Language (de jure official) 0.5%, other or not…
fields.religions: Christian 37.3% (Catholic 10.1%, Anglican 6.8%, Presbyterian and Congregational 5.2%, Pentecostal 1.8%, Methodist 1.6%, Church of Jesus Christ 1.2%, other 10.7%), Hindu 2.7%, Maori 1.3%, Muslim…

system.text: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

fields.legal: common law system, based on English model, with special legislation and land courts for the Maori
fields.military: 17 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; soldiers cannot be deployed until the age of 18; no conscription
